name: Capture Alive
body:
School necromancy; Level cleric/oracle 0, druid 0, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (bit of cotton fluff)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fortitude negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The non-magical melee damage dealt by the subject of this spell to living creatures is magically transformed into nonlethal damage.
